feed.title: Google Cloud: Data Studio
feed.subtitle: Changelog for Google Cloud product: Data Studio

entry.content:
Bulk styling

You can customize all series, dimensions, or metrics at once, or select an individual item to style it separately. Styles that you set for an individual item override styles that you set for all items.

For more information, see the Line chart and combo chart reference, Time series reference, and Table reference.
entry.summary: Customize multiple chart elements at once with bulk styling. Individual element styles will override group styles for more granular control.
entry.title: Feature: Bulk Styling Option

entry.content:
Connect to PostgreSQL (Private IP)

You can connect Data Studio to PostgreSQL databases on Cloud SQL by using a private IP address. Private IP connections keep your database traffic on a private network instead of the public internet.

For more information, see Connect to PostgreSQL.
entry.summary: Data Studio now supports private IP connections to PostgreSQL databases on Cloud SQL. This feature routes your database traffic through a private network, enhancing security by avoiding the public internet.
entry.title: Feature: Connect to PostgreSQL via Private IP

entry.content:
MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 deprecation

Support for MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 in the MySQL connector is ending:

  • Creating new data sources that connect to MySQL 5.6 or 5.7 won't be possible after February 26, 2027.
  • Data sources or reports that use MySQL 5.6 or 5.7 might not properly load data after February 26, 2027.

For more information, see Connect to MySQL.
entry.summary: Support for MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 is ending. After February 26, 2027, new data source creation will be blocked, and existing connections may experience issues. Please migrate to a supported version to ensure continued functionality.
entry.title: Deprecated: MySQL 5.6 and 5.7 Deprecation

entry.content: The following features are rolling out over the next week.
entry.summary: New features are being released over the next week. This update brings a variety of enhancements to improve your experience.
entry.title: Announcement: New features rolling out

entry.content:
Fullscreen charts

You can view individual charts in fullscreen mode. Click the fullscreen button in the chart header to expand the chart. This feature is not available for scorecards and gauge charts.
entry.summary: You can now view individual charts in fullscreen mode by clicking the fullscreen button in the chart header. This feature allows for a more detailed look at your data. Note that this is not available for scorecards and gauge charts.
entry.title: Feature: View charts in fullscreen

entry.content:
Rotate components

You can rotate text boxes, images, and shapes in Data Studio. Report creators can rotate these components on a non-responsive canvas and can reset the rotation to 0 degrees.
entry.summary: You can now rotate text boxes, images, and shapes in Data Studio. This feature allows report creators to adjust the orientation of components on a non-responsive canvas and reset them to their original position.
entry.title: Feature: Rotate components in reports

entry.content:
Center labels on stacked bar charts

You can position labels in the center of stacked bar charts. If insufficient space is available to center the label within the bar, the label is displayed outside the bar.

For more information, see the Bar chart and column chart reference.
entry.summary: You can now center labels on stacked bar charts. Labels will appear inside the bar if there's enough space, or outside if not.
entry.title: Feature: Center labels on stacked bars

entry.content:
Search for settings

You can search for settings in the Setup and Style tabs of the properties panel.
entry.summary: You can now search for settings within the Setup and Style tabs of the properties panel. This feature helps you quickly find the settings you need.
entry.title: Feature: Search for settings

entry.content:
Copy chart as image

You can copy a chart as a PNG image to your clipboard.
entry.summary: You can now copy charts as PNG images directly to your clipboard. This feature allows for easy inclusion of visual data in your documents and presentations.
entry.title: Feature: Copy chart as image

entry.content:
Bubble chart border color

You can modify the border color of bubbles in bubble charts.
entry.summary: You can now modify the border color of bubbles in bubble charts. This new feature allows for greater customization and visual appeal in your data representations.
entry.title: Feature: Customize bubble chart borders

entry.content: The following features are rolling out over the next week.
entry.summary: Exciting new features are being released over the next week. We can't wait for you to try them out.
entry.title: Announcement: New features rolling out

entry.content:
Conversational Analytics is generally available

Conversational Analytics in Data Studio is now generally available. You can now filter your data agents by the Google Cloud project to which they belong. Agents that require additional permissions are now displayed with an Unavailable label.
entry.summary: Conversational Analytics in Data Studio has reached general availability. Users can now filter data agents by their Google Cloud project and will see an 'Unavailable' label for agents requiring additional permissions.
entry.title: Feature: Conversational Analytics Now Generally Available

entry.content:
Email notifications when sharing Conversational Analytics data agents

When you share data agents that were created in BigQuery with Data Studio users, you can opt to send an email to notify those users of their access to the agent.
entry.summary: You can now opt to send email notifications when sharing data agents created in BigQuery with Data Studio users. This feature helps ensure users are aware when they gain access to a data agent.
entry.title: Feature: Email notifications for shared data agents

entry.content:
Viewer data refresh

Report editors can now allow report viewers to manually refresh report data. When editors enable the new Viewer data refresh option in report settings, viewers can refresh data for a component by right clicking the component, or refresh data for a report by selecting the option in the three-dot menu.
entry.summary: Report editors can now enable viewers to manually refresh report data. Viewers can refresh individual components or the entire report through simple right-click or menu options.
entry.title: Feature: Viewer data refresh

entry.content:
Pro feature: Security and compliance enhancements

The following features are now available to help you meet your organization's security and compliance needs. These features are only available for Data Studio Pro.

  • Customer-managed encryption keys (CMEK): Use your own cryptographic keys to protect Data Studio Pro assets.
  • Customer-managed storage: Store your file uploads in your own Cloud Storage bucket and your data extracts in your own BigQuery dataset.
  • Data residency: Keep your data physically within a geographical area.
entry.summary: Data Studio Pro now offers advanced security and compliance features, including customer-managed encryption keys, customer-managed storage options, and data residency controls. These enhancements empower organizations to better protect their data and meet regulatory requirements.
entry.title: Feature: New security and compliance features for Data Studio Pro

entry.content:
Regionalization in CA in Data Studio

Conversational Analytics in Data Studio now supports multi-region BigQuery data agents.

Learn more about Conversational Analytics in Data Studio.
entry.summary: Conversational Analytics in Data Studio now works with BigQuery data sources across multiple regions. This update enhances flexibility for users working with geographically distributed data. Learn more about this new capability.
entry.title: Feature: Regional BigQuery support for Conversational Analytics
